# Introduction {#sec-intro}

Replace this chapter with your own introduction. Within the first page or
two, tell the reader what question you ask, why it matters, how you answer
it, what you find, and what your work adds to what is already known.

End with a short roadmap. In this template, @sec-guide is a worked example of
the tools you need to write a thesis in Quarto: citations, equations,
figures, tables and cross-references. @sec-conclusion concludes, and
@sec-appendix-tables shows how an appendix is numbered. The last page holds
the declaration of authorship you sign.
